programme.title: Chingari
programme.desc: A prostitute leads a glum life but finds happiness and hope when she falls in love with a postman. However, things take a turn when a priest, who disapproves of the alliance, gets him killed.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Anari Ishq

programme.desc: River Deep: The team risk it all to keep Norway's most treacherous roads open. But if anything is damaged during a rescue, they could find themselves facing a crippling bill. (S3, ep 7) 7+

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Heir to the Clan: The daughter of an alpha female, hyena Spotty is a princess. But in a competitive family, she must cement her status quickly or lose her rank forever. (S2, ep 6) 7+

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Tropical Thunder: A tiger's hunger for territory results in a fatal conflict with its own kind. Two huge monitor lizards fight it out in a nail-biting battle for dominance. (S2, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: I've Never Met Herbivore: Dr Pol welcomes a new vet to the clinic - just in time to help with a wave of cases. Plus, Dr Nicole examines a service dog after a scuffle. 7+. (2 of 10)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: License to Quill: It's Dr Oakley's to the rescue when dog Harper gets caught in a prickly situation. Later, she squares off with a muskox and a bear cub undergoes surgery. (S5, ep 3)

programme.title: Bizarre Animal Friends
programme.desc: The Most Unlikely Of All: A look back at the most touching, strange and shocking animal friendships of the series, including a tortoise that struggles to keep up with his hippo pal. 7+

programme.title: Cruise TV With Loveitbookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise holiday is your greatest one!

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: You Ain't Nothing But a Hound Dog: Dr Oakley treats a deer with a limp and an alpaca-llama cross with an attitude, and guards the family dog from a wandering hound. (S8, ep 11) 7+

programme.title: Fish Tank Kings
programme.desc: Desperate Housetanks: Ben is tasked to install two over-sized tanks in an Orlando mansion. Plus, the survival of a rare frog hangs on Mat building it the perfect terrarium. (S2, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: America The Wild
programme.desc: Super Moose: Wildlife tracker Casey Anderson sets out to discover the bizarre behaviour of moose in mating season. He finds a scene he never thought he would witness. (3 of 6) 7+

programme.title: Fish My City
programme.desc: Giants of Taipei: Mike searches Taiwan's capital for a beastly behemoth with teeth like a shark's and flushes out a drain-dwelling monster that fled a fish farm. (S1, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: You Got a Vet in Me: The vets at PVS value the bond between owner and pet. That's why they work tirelessly to heal each animal to reassure their clients along the way. (S11, ep 11) 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Bear Brawl: Dr Michelle Oakley gets caught in the middle of a brawl between two bear brothers. Plus, an injured horse fights back and an alpaca requires urgent attention. (S4, ep 8)

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Spanning Africa's mighty rivers, many imposing animals inhabit the waters. Explore the vast range of animals - from mighty to miniscule - that occupy these rivers. 7+

programme.title: Close Encounters Of The Wild Kind
programme.desc: Urban Jungle: Soon two-thirds of the global population will be living in cities, leaving wild animals to develop a whole new set of street smarts. (S1, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Big Bear Theory: After a series of mishaps, Sloth Bear Heidi Rose is ready to find a mate. Plus, the team helps a Three Banded Armadillo het his groove back. (S2, ep 20) 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Days of Destruction: When a landslip takes out an excavator on a remote forest track, Thord and Bjoern join forces, but the unstable ground threatens the rescue. (S10, 7 of 8) 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Cat Out of Hell: An unusual line-up of patients test Yukon vet Dr Michelle Oakley's mettle, including a Himalayan yak that shocks everyone when he wakes up during surgery. 7+ (S3, ep 8)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Mandrill of the House: An older male mandrill shows his true colours during a dental exam. Plus, teamwork is critical as a gigantic female bison gets a physical. (S2, ep 18) 7+

programme.title: Birth Of Europe
programme.desc: Water: Explore the remarkable geological past and present of Europe, a continent born from colliding land masses, erupting volcanoes, earthquakes and huge asteroid impacts. (1 of 3) 7+

programme.title: Birth Of Europe
programme.desc: Collision: Discover how a violent history of crashing land masses and shattering earthquakes helped to create the Europe we know today. (2 of 3) 7+

programme.title: Life Below Zero: Next Generation
programme.desc: The Messenger: Chevie Roach protects his family from an unwanted messenger, while Johnny Rolfe embarks on a unique caribou hunt. (S7, ep 6)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Mean Machine: The ice road rescuers spring into action when a 30-tonne excavator upends itself in a deep ditch in the South of Norway. (S3, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: Zambia Untamed
programme.desc: The Outcasts: In Zambia's Luangwa Valley, a young baboon faces exclusion from his troop because of his white hair. With predators lurking, his mother must find him support. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: America's Wild Seasons
programme.desc: Spring: Across the continent, spring brings warmth and renewal. For some animals, courtship rituals begin to heat up as battles for dominance break out. (S1, ep 1)
